articles.title: The Nobel Prize committee doesn’t want Trump getting one, even as a gift—but they treated Obama very differently
articles.mainIdea: The Nobel Prize committee doesn’t want Trump getting one, even as a gift—but they treated Obama very differently
articles.summary: Fortune: The Nobel Prize committee doesn’t want Trump getting one, even as a gift—but they treated Obama very differently. There isn't a Nobel double standard when it comes to regifting or auctions. One even sold for a whopping $103.5 million.

articles.title: 'Nothing's changed' in Gaza as US peace deal enters second phase
articles.mainIdea: 'Nothing's changed' in Gaza as US peace deal enters second phase
articles.summary: AFP: 'Nothing's changed' in Gaza as US peace deal enters second phase. From his tent in Gaza City, Mahmoud Abdel Aal said residents were frustrated and worried because nothing had changed in the Palestinian territory since the start of the US-brokered ceasefire's second phase."Everyone is worried and frustrated because nothing's changed."

articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: U.S. Futures Suggest Tech Rally Will Continue, Though Global Markets Falter. Nasdaq futures were climbing as the rally sparked by TSMC earnings looked set to continue. Asian and European stocks slipped, along with precious metals.
